```{r, include=FALSE}
library(highcharter)
options(highcharter.google_fonts = FALSE)
```

`highchart(type = "stock")` adds the Stock navigator and range selector.
Use `highchartstock()` when readers also need drawing tools and technical
indicators. All prices in these examples come from the xts package's sample
OHLC matrix.

```{r}
data(sample_matrix, package = "xts")
prices <- xts::as.xts(sample_matrix)
hchart(prices, id = "price", name = "Sample instrument")
```

## Lines and price bars

One ordinary column produces a line. Several columns such as the two below
produce one named line each. All four price fields together produce candles.
Use `type = "ohlc"` for open–high–low–close bars.

```{r}
hchart(prices[, "Close"], name = "Close")
hchart(prices[, c("Open", "Close")])
hchart(prices, type = "ohlc", name = "Sample instrument")
```

## Flags, navigator and indicators

The flag and moving average select the price series by ID. The range selector
and navigator act on the same time axis. Open the Stock Tools toolbar to add
an indicator interactively.

```{r}
price_chart <- highchartstock() |>
  hc_add_series(prices, name = "Price", id = "price") |>
  hc_add_series(type = "sma", linkedTo = "price", name = "10-day mean",
                params = list(period = 10)) |>
  hc_add_series(type = "flags", onSeries = "price", data = list(
    list(x = datetime_to_timestamp(time(prices)[30]), title = "A", text = "Day 30")
  )) |>
  hc_stockTools(gui = list(enabled = TRUE, buttons = c("indicators", "zoomChange", "fullScreen"))) |>
  hc_rangeSelector(selected = 0) |>
  hc_navigator(enabled = TRUE)

price_chart
```

## Two stacked panels

The price and the daily trading range have separate scales. Their heights are
in the ratio 3 to 1. The panels share the time axis.

```{r}
daily_range <- prices[, "High"] - prices[, "Low"]
highchart(type = "stock") |>
  hc_yAxis(create_axis(2, heights = c(3, 1))) |>
  hc_add_series(prices, name = "Price", yAxis = 0) |>
  hc_add_series(daily_range, name = "High minus low", type = "column", yAxis = 1)
```

## Update a series and its visible range in Shiny

Run the app below, then press **Update**. The stock widget stays mounted while
the proxy changes the selected series and the x-axis range. Redraw the updated
series before setting the range so the Stock navigator has its new data limits.

```{r stock-proxy, eval=FALSE, code=readLines(system.file("examples", "stock-proxy.R", package="highcharter"))}
```
